PPN = DPP Nilai Lain × tarif nominal. Ba: VAT = other tax base (DPP Nilai Lain) × nominal rate. Non-luxury goods/services: 12% × 11/12 base = 11% effective; luxury goods a full 12%. Export 0% stays creditable, Exempt 0% is not creditable — non-creditable input VAT is booked as part of the expense/asset, not to the Input VAT account.
